definitions.ja: 高い；値段が高い；高価な
definitions.km: ថ្លៃ; មានតម្លៃខ្ពស់
definitions.th: แพง; ราคาสูง; มีราคาแพง

lao_examples.lao_script: ໂທລະສັບໃໝ່ເຄື່ອງນີ້ແພງຫຼາຍ ຊື້ບໍ່ໄດ້
lao_examples.romanization: tʰóː lā sáp mài khɨ̂aŋ níː phɛ́ːŋ lǎːj, sɨ́ː bɔ̀ː dâj
lao_examples.translation_en: This new phone is really expensive, I can't buy it.

lao_examples.lao_script: ຂອງຢູ່ຕະຫຼາດນີ້ແພງກວ່າໃນເມືອງ
lao_examples.romanization: khɔ̌ːŋ yùː tā làːt níː phɛ́ːŋ kwàː naj mɨ́aŋ
lao_examples.translation_en: Stuff at this market is more expensive than in the city.
